name: Group of Monuments at Mahabalipuram
description: On the Bay of Bengal coast about 60 km south of Chennai, Mahabalipuram holds around 40 monuments carved by the Pallava kings in the 7th and 8th centuries. You can walk among temples cut from single boulders to resemble chariots, explore rock-hewn cave sanctuaries, and stand before the vast open-air relief of the Descent of the Ganges, one of the largest in the world.
